userStories.title: Sandbox image Dockerfile (Node 20 + Python + uv/npx)
userStories.userStory: As platform I need a reproducible sandbox image so each org container can run arbitrary npx MCP servers.
acceptanceCriteria: Image builds with docker build; exposes sandbox-agent on port 9320
Gate: docker build -t ai-mesh/mcp-sandbox:latest services/mcp-broker/sandbox-image succeeds

userStories.title: In-container sandbox-agent (stdio JSON-RPC over HTTP)
userStories.userStory: As broker I need an in-container agent that spawns and talks to stdio MCP children.

userStories.title: Shared env denylist and OAuth heuristics
userStories.userStory: As security I need identical denylist/OAuth rules in gateway and sandbox-agent.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests prove denylist blocks GATEWAY_INTERNAL_API_KEY in child env

userStories.title: Broker Docker SDK lifecycle manager
userStories.userStory: As broker I need to create/stop/destroy per-org sandbox containers.

userStories.title: Sandbox registry and idle reaper
userStories.userStory: As ops I need idle sandboxes stopped after MCP_SANDBOX_IDLE_TIMEOUT.
acceptanceCriteria: Reaper stops container after idle timeout (mock clock in tests)

userStories.title: Sandbox Controller REST API routes
userStories.userStory: As gateway I need broker endpoints for ensure, stdio/rpc, status, destroy.

userStories.title: Broker internal auth middleware
userStories.userStory: As security I need MCP_BROKER_INTERNAL_KEY on all sandbox API calls.

userStories.title: Wire sandbox module into FastAPI + health docker check
userStories.userStory: As deployer I need /health to report Docker connectivity.

userStories.title: Broker Dockerfile and docker-compose sandbox wiring
userStories.userStory: As dev I need compose profile to run broker with Docker socket and sandbox network.
acceptanceCriteria: services/mcp-broker/Dockerfile; docker-compose mounts /var/run/docker.sock on mcp-broker only
mcp_sandbox_bridge network; MCP_BROKER_INTERNAL_KEY, MCP_STDIO_IN_PROCESS=false on gateway
Gate: docker compose --profile services config validates

userStories.title: Gateway mcp_sandbox_client.py HTTP client
userStories.userStory: As gateway I need HTTP client wrapping broker stdio/rpc and ensure.
acceptanceCriteria: Retries on 503 with backoff; timeouts from MCP_STDIO_* env

userStories.title: Branch mcp_stdio_adapter on MCP_STDIO_IN_PROCESS
userStories.userStory: As dev I need in-process fallback; as prod I need broker delegation.
acceptanceCriteria: send_jsonrpc routes to broker when MCP_STDIO_IN_PROCESS=false
Existing in-process tests still pass with MCP_STDIO_IN_PROCESS=true
Gate: cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests -q green

userStories.title: MCP path rate limiting (TPM + burst/RPM)
userStories.userStory: As operator I need MCP JSON-RPC rate limited like chat paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate: new test in gateway tests proves 429 on exceed

userStories.title: Docker integration test (single org, single server)
userStories.userStory: As CI I need one real Docker integration test before load gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Assert process runs in labeled container; no cross-org file leakage
Gate: runs green when Docker available

userStories.title: 5x5 parallel sandbox load test
userStories.userStory: As platform I need proof that 5 orgs x 5 MCP servers run concurrently without leakage.
acceptanceCriteria: MCP_STDIO_IN_PROCESS=false, real Docker; no cross-tenant leakage

userStories.title: MCPConnectorPanel sandbox path verification
userStories.userStory: As user I can register stdio MCP via UI with sandbox backend.
acceptanceCriteria: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build green
Playwright or browser: stdio preset registration, tools/list, tools/call
Update MCPConnectorPanel comment re per-org sandbox
